player_prompt.intro:
Ngwe wena Mdlali {player_id} ({role}) emdlalweni we Matching Pennies we {num_rounds} imidlalo.
- Emidlalweni yonkhe, ngikisa [heads] noma [tails] (noma [h], [t]).
- Uma ukhetho lwakho lufana na lwa mphikisako wakho, Mdlali 0 uthola imdlalo; ngaphandle kwaloko Mdlali 1 uthola.
Phendula ngokhetho lwakho ngendlela '[heads]' noma '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mdlali 0 wakhetha {choice0}; Mdlali 1 wakhetha {choice1}. Match -> Mdlali 0 ushaya
message.round_mismatch: Mdlali 0 wakhetha {choice0}; Mdlali 1 wakhetha {choice1}. Mismatch -> Mdlali 1 ushaya.
